preconditions.description: The number of vertices N is at least 3, and the number of queries M is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects vertices within the valid range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N and 1 <= q <= N for p, q in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of vertices P and Q within the valid range [1, N].
For each query, P is not a leaf vertex (has at least two neighbors).

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == M, output[i] >= 1 for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly M integers, each representing a valid sequence length X >= 1 for the corresponding query.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(dis(A[i], A[i+1]) == i+1 for i in range(X-1)) for A in possible_sequences[P][Q]) for P, Q in queries)
postconditions.description: For each query (P, Q), the output X is the maximum length of a *cool* sequence starting at P and ending at Q, where dis(A[i], A[i+1]) = i for 1 ≤ i < X.

postconditions.expression: all(X == max(len(A) for A in possible_sequences[P][Q]) for (P, Q), X in zip(queries, output))
postconditions.description: The output X for each query (P, Q) is the maximum possible length of a *cool* sequence starting at P and ending at Q.
